blocks.name: Header and navigation
blocks.contract: Full approved logo; Services, Locations, Pricing, Our Work, Resources, About; primary quote, secondary phone. Mobile is an expandable menu, not a compressed desktop menu.

blocks.name: Footer and business identity
blocks.contract: Consistent full name, 1800 934 009, verified contact/profile links, service and location navigation, policies; no invented office addresses.

blocks.name: Mobile action area
blocks.contract: Quote-first action; secondary call. Reserve safe-area space; suppress obstruction during form entry. Support/legal/404 variants may omit persistent sales actions.

blocks.name: Breadcrumbs
blocks.contract: One meaningful parent chain with real crawlable ancestors; locality identity stays stable across region crosslinks.

blocks.name: Intent-led introduction
blocks.contract: One H1, who/what/where where relevant, short customer outcome, truthful next action; optional illustrative image never presented as job proof.

blocks.name: Direct answer / key facts
blocks.contract: Concise self-contained answer or summary with important scope/price qualifications beside the claim, not hidden below.

blocks.name: Service selection cards
blocks.contract: Service ID, customer task, brief scope distinction and descriptive canonical link; do not create pages for synonyms.

blocks.name: Locality finder
blocks.contract: Suburb/postcode input, same-name disambiguation, matched locality ID, clear coverage vs availability wording; unknown input is not automatically unserved.

blocks.name: Geographic directory
blocks.contract: State/region/locality links with verified hierarchy; paginate large lists; map optional and never sole navigation.

blocks.name: Inclusions and exclusions
blocks.contract: Service-specific scope, explicit exclusions and assessment conditions; same approved scope record reused consistently.

blocks.name: Extras and suitability
blocks.contract: Optional items, eligibility/material limitations, scope changes and approval before additional work; no assumed cross-service inclusions.

blocks.name: Pricing and cost factors
blocks.contract: Approved rates/ranges when available, charging unit, tax treatment, scope, factors, extras and date; otherwise explain assessment without inventing a figure.

blocks.name: Estimate component
blocks.contract: Only use approved calculator rules; selected scope, estimate range and qualification, tailored-quote path for unpriced work, handoff to universal form.

blocks.name: Process and next steps
blocks.contract: Numbered 01/02/03 steps reflecting the real enquiry-to-confirmation-to-service journey; no fabricated booking or response promise.

blocks.name: Case study cards
blocks.contract: Actual approved jobs, relevant service/location relationships, observed outcome and link; omit when no appropriate evidence.

blocks.name: Evidence gallery
blocks.contract: Consented same-job before/after assets, captions and honest comparison; keyboard/touch navigation; no fabricated image provenance.

blocks.name: Review display
blocks.contract: Source, date, original meaning and applicable service/locality; ratings only where supported; no uncited star count.

blocks.name: Credentials and accountability
blocks.contract: Only documented insurance/credentials or real responsible people; link evidence where suitable; no generic trust badge filler.

blocks.name: Decision FAQs
blocks.contract: Real page-specific objections, concise answers and qualification links. Add suburb only where meaning requires it; no forced question count.

blocks.name: Related links
blocks.contract: Curated contextual services, guides, pricing, checklists, cases or locations; explain the relevance rather than adding a large keyword link cloud.

blocks.name: Conversion handoff
blocks.contract: One form-first action and secondary 1800 934 009 call where appropriate; preserve selected context without technical customer-facing explanation.

blocks.name: Policy and reassurance
blocks.contract: Approved eligibility, scope, time window, exclusions, reporting steps and full terms link; not an unconditional guarantee.

blocks.name: Interactive / printable checklist
blocks.contract: Tasks grouped by room or surface, included/extra/not included status, conditional notes, scope version and print view. No login gate for core scope.

blocks.name: On-page contents
blocks.contract: Anchor links to meaningful sections; visible keyboard focus, sticky-header offset and no automatic scroll hijacking.

blocks.name: Editorial body
blocks.contract: Readable sections with direct answers, concrete examples, material/safety limits and appropriate sources; no fixed word-count padding.

blocks.name: Comparison / decision table
blocks.contract: Consistent comparison criteria, suitability and limitations; compare supported methods or scope, not unsupported competitor claims.

blocks.name: Author and review details
blocks.contract: Actual author/reviewer and relevant experience, publication and substantive update dates; never invent a person or artificial freshness.

blocks.name: Sources and methodology
blocks.contract: Source links, provenance, methods, limitations and reviewed date for factual/technical claims; distinguish job evidence from outside advice.

blocks.name: Filters and search
blocks.contract: Useful service/location/topic filtering, visible active filters, result count and clear reset; keyboard accessible and no endless indexable combinations.

blocks.name: Content results
blocks.contract: Cards for articles, guides, cases or reviews with accurate type-specific metadata and helpful empty states; select type as a variant.

blocks.name: Pagination
blocks.contract: Crawlable next/previous and numbered pages with stable URLs when needed; optional load-more enhances rather than replaces access.

blocks.name: Job facts
blocks.contract: Service, general locality, property/surface, objective, constraints, date and approved outcome; no private address or invented measurements.

blocks.name: Case narrative
blocks.contract: Problem → agreed scope → process → observed result → limitations/lessons, tied to real evidence; service-specific fields.

blocks.name: Review provenance
blocks.contract: Explain collection/source and moderation honestly; deduplicate records and distinguish rated reviews from unrated testimonials.

blocks.name: Brand story and standards
blocks.contract: Verified identity/history plus demonstrable scope, quote and service standards; do not convert aspirations into historical facts.

blocks.name: Partner proposition
blocks.contract: Approved partnership types, audience fit, responsibilities, enquiry route and next steps; no invented franchise/referral earnings.

blocks.name: Progressive enquiry form
blocks.contract: Service-aware questions, accessible labels/validation, separate property/contact steps, consent, preserved entries and recovery; field configuration still awaits user input.

blocks.name: Editable request summary
blocks.contract: Selected services/location, approved estimate assumptions, edit links and recalculation on scope change; technical IDs remain internal.

blocks.name: Submission and recovery states
blocks.contract: Loading, inline error, network retry, accepted enquiry and duplicate protection; success only after lead acceptance, not booking confirmation.

blocks.name: Support pathways
blocks.contract: New quote vs existing enquiry vs service concern; contact methods and factual expectations; sensitive information stays out of public pages.

blocks.name: Policy document
blocks.contract: Owner, effective/reviewed date, readable clauses, contact route and controlled revision history; owner-approved text rather than marketing promises.

blocks.name: HTML sitemap groups
blocks.contract: Hierarchical canonical links to services, resources and paginated location indexes; exclude private sessions, duplicate filters and unpublished paths.

blocks.name: Not-found recovery
blocks.contract: Plain missing-page explanation, useful service/location search and main routes; actual HTTP 404, no fake successful page.

blocks.name: Relevant local / service context
blocks.contract: Verified property/access or material requirements that alter the customer decision. Do not infer local housing characteristics from income, population or place names.
